keyPhrases.text: chief strengths are its lead performances
doesn't really have much to do with the actual show
more than stands up on its own

reasoning: Strong 4-star review with enthusiastic praise for performances (Redmayne 'mesmerizing', Rankin 'stunning', veterans 'nearly steal the show') and staging described as 'undeniably powerful'. Minor criticisms include calling it 'somewhat imperfect' and questioning necessity of pre-show elements, but overall highly recommends the production.
